title: Addition of step counts
statement: For a width $w$, a relation $E$ on Boolean strings, and a natural number $r$, define an $r$-step chain from $A$ to $B$ by requiring $A=B$ when $r=0$, and otherwise requiring a length-$w$ string $z$ with an $(r-1)$-step chain from $A$ to $z$ and $E(z,B)$. For all natural numbers $m,k$ and strings $A,B$ of length $w$, an $(k+m)$-step chain from $A$ to $B$ exists if and only if there is a length-$w$ string $z$ such that there is a $k$-step chain from $A$ to $z$ and an $m$-step chain from $z$ to $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a relation on Boolean strings
